title: EthWallet
description: This project aims to be a multifunction DeFi wallet that allows for the creation, storage and trade of ERC20 tokens which can then be used to stake and other financial transactions through protocols like UMA, Saved and Uniswap. In the future, there are plans to incorporate textile for storage.
how_its_made: After reading through the ERC20 standard, Uniswap, UMA protocol, and youtube tutorials, the final project used the same tools from our previous project. The tools used: solc v0.7.0, and Node v14 along with Truffle, Solidity, Web3.js and React and Bootstrap for the frontend. We plan to implement this app as a supplement to supply chain apps as a way to offer incentives for adoption.
